text:
Alex: Heads-up — we should run a focused load test to validate admission/backpressure thresholds for GPU pools and KV cache effects. Goal: find queue length and rate-limit points where we should start shedding or routing to fallback models.
Jonas: +1. single-region (us-west-2) first to isolate infra.
Priya: 3-phase run: baseline, ramp, sustained. Keep cache warmup measurable; suggest 5/10/15m.
Maya: Pool = 8 GPUs (A100-equivalent) to mirror Dedicated default.
Alex: Target RPS: ~600rps short-context, ~200rps long-context. We'll run both variants.
Zoe: Two test variants for KV cache: high-prefix-hit (~70% repeated prompts) vs cold random prompts.
Carlos: Cost check: ~ $3.2/hr per GPU => 8 * 3.2 = $25.6/hr. ~1.5h total =~ $40. cc @ops-finance
Sam-bot: noted: loadtest scheduled id=bt-kvcache-2026-03
Jonas: Plan:
- Stage A (baseline): 5m warm @20% util
- Stage B (ramp): 10m linear ramp to target
- Stage C (sustain): 15m at target
Priya: Instrumentation: admission.admitted_total, admission.rejected_total, queue.backlog, gpu.util, batch.size, kv.cache_hit_ratio, request.latency_p95.
Alex: PromQL to watch live:
sum(rate(admission_rejected_total[1m])) by (pool)
max(queue_backlog) by (pool)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le, pool))
Maya: Track model_fallback_count to see routing triggers.
Zoe: Workload generator: 70% reuse for high-kv; cold uses UUIDs. Tag requests with x-loadtest-id and x-test-variant headers.
Carlos: Current admission policy: backlog > 100 => start shedding. Proposal: backlog > 50 for >30s OR gpu.util > 92% AND p95 latency > 750ms => route/shed.
Alex: Also validate batching behavior: backlog growth should not cause batch latency to explode. batch.size target < 32.
Jonas: k6 snippet for job payload (token redacted):
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  const body = JSON.stringify({ prompt: `<seed>-${__VU}-${__ITER}`, max_tokens: 64 });
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate', body, { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer TOKEN', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
}
```
Priya: Add headers: `x-loadtest-id: bt-kvcache-2026-03`, `x-test-variant: high-kvcache|cold` for trace filtering.
Maya: Run a 0.1x smoke now (10m) to validate dashboards and silence alerts. real run in maintenance window 02:00 UTC tomorrow if smoke passes.
Zoe: Success criteria:
- admission.rejected_total within expected shedding policy (graceful degradation)
- p95 < 900ms for short contexts when util < 90%
- KV cache yields >=2x token/sec improvement under high-hit
- batch.size < 32 most of the time
Jonas: Post-test: I'll assemble dashboard screenshots and short recommendations.
Carlos: I'll coordinate oncall and silence non-critical alerts for the window.
Alex: Action items:
- Jonas: produce k6 job + deploy to test cluster (today)
- Priya: add metrics/labels and tracing headers
- Zoe: build prompt sets for variants
- Maya: confirm pool config and finance OK
- Carlos: create alert silencing window
Reconvene in #eng-infra after the smoke pass. :thumbsup:
